readyBody: Pair each term with its definition as fast as you can. Tap two tiles, or drag one onto the other. A wrong pair adds a second.
mistakes: {count, plural, one {# wrong pair} other {# wrong pairs}}
notMatch: Not a match. One second added.
pairsLeft: {count, plural, one {# pair left} other {# pairs left}}
noScores: Finish a game to set your first time.
